messages:
elaine: FYI vendor just emailed — EU allocation for our Q3 order cut ~20%, new lead times 10-12w instead of 6-8w. Need plan for committed Dedicated customers + sparepool. Vendor attached revised ETA and an RMA note.

samir: ugh. which POs? can we reroute some capacity from US?

elaine: POs 2134/2135/2138. They said limited stock in EU pool, but US pool has 30% more availability if we accept cross-border import fees.

maria: this will impact Dedicated customers in EMEA on commits. we should flag >=SLA risk and prep credits. cc @kevin for RMA flow.

kevin: for RMAs — vendor offered partial replacements and consolidated AWB for returns, but charges apply for customs rework. can they pre-pay duties for air-expedites? vendor_rep_JP?

vendor_rep_JP: hi all — we can do a blended solution: move 40 units from US to EU with DDP option at +$120/unit, or keep in US and ship express per-case at +$250/expedite. For RMAs, we can provide cross-dock partial replace to reduce customs hold, but that needs a PO-level agreement and liability waiver.

elaine: cost math needed. if we move 40 units DDP vs per-case expedite, what's break-even? also need to decide sparepool usage policy for next 6 weeks.

alejandro: quick calc: DDP +$120 *40 = $4.8k. per-case expedite assume 20 cases at $250 = $5k. so DDP cheaper if we need bulk. But DDP eats allocation so svr capacity may be tight.

maria: recommend: 1) use sparepool to cover canary customers (5 nodes), 2) DDP for bulk redistribution (40), 3) request vendor credit for lead-time variance (10% of PO value).

samir: agree. also add option to swap-in older 80GB A6000-equivalent units temporarily (lower perf) to avoid SLA breaches. ops-team ok with quantization fallback?

kevin: ops can handle perf drop if we limit to non-latency critical routes. Need ticketed plan for RMA routing: prefer vendor cross-dock -> our EU depot -> customer. minimize customs hops.

logistics-bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-8942, assigned to @kevin. AWB options attached: https://carrier.example/awb/8942

vendor_rep_JP: we can offer 5% one-time credit on the affected PO if you accept DDP movement. Also can expedite RMAs if the liability waiver signed.

elaine: i'll take that to finance. action items: 
- elaine: request formal DDP quote + AWB sample from vendor (ETA 24h)
- samir: update capacity forecast & propose temporary SKU swap (ETA 48h)
- kevin: RMA routing playbook update + sign liability waiver template with vendor (ETA 72h)
- maria: draft customer communications & SLA credit template (ETA 48h)

samir: also enabling burst to US region for some customer routes might be faster. I'll open a Capacity Change request in infra: 
```
/infra capacity request --region us-east --gpu-count 16 --type burst --duration 2w
```

kevin: thanks. if vendor signs credit + we get DDP, we're OK. otherwise we'll start swapping SKUs and issuing credits to affected accounts.

elaine: scheduling short sync with vendor tomorrow 09:30 PT. invite sent. :calendar: 

maria: noted. thanks everyone.
